note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; terminal commands are typed and run for real. $env:MG_DEV_URL (DEV org URL) and the other MG_* variables are set by the owner as user environment variables on the laptop and never appear on screen.
prepare: Read-Host 'Owner: episode 1 is in DEV; canvas app Equipment Desk (phone) is built per demo.md (named formulas, BrowseScreen, LendScreen, delegation checked), saved and published; Data row limit is 1 for the first shot; CT-0042 is Available with no open loan; riley.demo role only if the warning cutaway is wanted. Press Enter'

screens.name: data-row-limit
steps: Solutions > Equipment Desk > 'Equipment Desk (phone)' > Edit (Power Apps Studio)
Close settings, Preview the app on BrowseScreen
Type CT-01 in the search box: CT-0107 and CT-0108 are both listed
Show that the gallery has no yellow delegation triangle
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu

screens.name: lend-validation
steps: In Studio preview (phone layout) tap CT-0042 Laptop 14 on BrowseScreen
Set the due date one day before the loan date
Show the red label 'The due date can't be before the loan date.' and the greyed Lend button
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: saved
steps: Fix the due date and tap Lend
Show the green 'Loan saved: CT-0042' notification and the return to BrowseScreen
Switch 'Available only' on: CT-0042 is gone from the list
Optional cutaway (signed in as riley.demo with the limited role): yellow 'Loan saved, but the device status wasn't updated: ...'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

screens.name: model-driven-loan
steps: Open Loans: the new loan for CT-0042 is in the view
Open Equipment: CT-0042 shows Status 'On loan'
mask: environment name and org URL in the address bar and the environment picker
tenant name in the top bar
account name, e-mail and avatar in the account menu
any real mail domain: only the fictional *.demo@contoso.com addresses may stay

teardown: Write-Host 'Reminder: Data row limit back to 500, delete the test loan for CT-0042 and set it back to Available, remove riley.demo role assignment and the limited role.'
